message: As we think about being prepared, it’s easy to overlook the little things that can make a big difference. We all know how frustrating it can be when our phone or tech dies at the worst moment—especially when we’re relying on it for information or connection. That’s why having a well-thought-out survival kit can be a real lifesaver. It’s not just about the essentials; it’s about peace of mind knowing we have what we need, even when our gadgets fail us. Let’s take a moment to assess our own kits and make sure we’re ready for anything that comes our way. What’s one item you’ve found indispensable in your own preparations? 😊
